name: Popup Builder & Opt-in Forms – Exit Intent, Coupon & Floating Bar Popups by YSLeadGen
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YSLeadGen is a popup plugin that helps turn website visitors into leads, subscribers, and customers.

Many people visit a website but leave without subscribing or taking action. This popup builder helps capture those opportunities by showing the right message at the right moment. You can display popups when a visitor is about to leave, after they scroll through your content, or once they spend time on a page.

With this WordPress popup plugin you can create lead generation popups, email opt-in forms, exit-intent popups, promotional popups, countdown popups, and floating notification bars directly from your WordPress dashboard.

These popup campaigns help you:

  • Grow your email subscriber list
  • Promote discounts and special offers
  • Collect leads and contact information
  • Reduce cart abandonment
  • Increase conversions from existing website traffic

Everything works directly inside WordPress. There is no need to create external accounts or manage separate dashboards. Popup campaigns and captured leads remain stored on your website so you stay in control of your data.

Getting started is simple. Choose a popup template, customize the design to match your site, define when the popup should appear, and publish the campaign. No coding knowledge is required.

YSLeadGen is built for website owners who want a flexible popup builder that is easy to use while still offering powerful targeting and display controls.

Useful resources:

Try Live Demo – https://demo.ysleadgen.com
Documentation – https://docs.ysleadgen.com
Support – https://ysleadgen.com/support
Visit Our Website – https://ysleadgen.com

Popup Types You Can Create

This popup plugin supports multiple popup styles so you can choose what fits your marketing goals.

Lead Generation Popups

Capture email subscribers, signups, and contact information from visitors who are interested in your content.

Exit-Intent Popups

Show a final message when visitors are about to leave your website. This can help recover leads or promote special offers.

Lightbox Popups

Display popups in the center of the screen to attract attention while keeping your page content visible.

Coupon Code & Promotion Popups

Share discount codes, flash sales, and promotional campaigns to encourage purchases and signups.

Floating Notification Bars (Sticky Bars)

Display a small notification bar at the top or bottom of the page to highlight announcements or promotions.

Scroll-Triggered Popups

Trigger popups after visitors scroll through part of your content, ensuring they appear to engaged readers.

Timed / Delayed Popups

Display popups after visitors stay on a page for a specific amount of time.

Cart Abandonment Popups

Remind visitors about offers or discounts before they leave without completing a purchase.

Multi-Step Popups

Guide visitors through a simple step-by-step flow that can increase engagement and lead capture.

Countdown Timer Popups

Create urgency by displaying a countdown timer for limited-time promotions.

Webinar Registration Popups

Collect registrations for webinars, events, or live sessions directly from your website.

Page-Based Popups

Show different popups on specific pages or posts depending on the content.

Device-Specific Popups

Create different popup experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile visitors.

Location-Based Popups

Display popups based on a visitor’s country or region.

Designing Your Popups

YSLeadGen includes a visual popup builder that makes popup creation simple.

  • Drag-and-drop popup builder
  • Ready-made popup templates
  • Mobile-responsive designs
  • Popup position and animation controls
  • Custom colors, fonts, and layout settings

When Do Popups Appear?

Control exactly when popups appear using flexible trigger rules.

  • New visitors – show popups only to first-time visitors
  • Returning visitors – display different messages to repeat visitors
  • Exit intent – trigger popups when visitors are about to leave
  • Time on site – show popups after visitors stay for a selected time
  • Scroll percentage – trigger popups after scrolling through content
  • Inactivity – display popups when visitors stop interacting
  • Auto close – automatically close popups after a set time

Targeting & Display Rules

Control where popup campaigns appear on your website.

  • Page-level targeting
  • Device targeting
  • Frequency control
  • Date and time scheduling

Built-In Analytics

Track how your popups perform without external tools.

  • Popup impressions
  • Form submissions
  • Conversion tracking
  • Analytics export

Lead Management

Manage captured leads directly inside WordPress.

  • Leads stored in the WordPress database
  • Central lead dashboard
  • CSV export
  • Custom fields
  • Email notifications

Privacy & Spam Protection

YSLeadGen is designed with privacy in mind.

  • Spam protection options
  • GDPR consent support
  • No external data sharing unless integrations are enabled

Privacy Policy

YSLeadGen stores popup settings, leads, and analytics locally in your WordPress database.

No data is shared externally unless integrations are enabled.

Privacy Policy: https://ysleadgen.com/privacy-policy

Support

Documentation: https://docs.ysleadgen.com
Support: https://ysleadgen.com/support

About

YSLeadGen is developed by YS Innovations and focuses on building practical WordPress tools that help website owners capture leads and grow their audience.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “YSLeadGen”
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Start creating popups from the YSLeadGen menu

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP file
  2. Install and activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Is YSLeadGen free to use?

Yes. The plugin includes core popup and lead generation features for free. Premium add-ons are optional.

Do I need to create an external account?

No. You can create and manage popup campaigns directly inside WordPress.

Where are my leads stored?

All leads are stored locally in your WordPress database and remain under your control.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

YSLeadGen loads only the resources needed for popup campaigns, helping maintain good website performance.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. All popups are responsive and adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Can I control when and where popups appear?

Yes. You can choose which pages display popups and configure trigger rules.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Popup settings and captured leads remain in your database.

1.1.6

  • Fixed close button styling conflict with some themes.
  • Added additional configuration options for Floating Bar popups.
  • Added Phone Input block for collecting phone numbers in popup forms.
  • Minor UI and compatibility improvements.
  • Plugin name changed.

1.1.5

  • Security fix: Resolved CVE-2026-1255 related to unauthenticated AJAX access.
  • Restricted captured lead data access to authenticated administrators only.
  • Added proper nonce validation and capability checks.
  • Removed unauthenticated (nopriv) AJAX actions.
  • Implemented REST API endpoints with proper permission validation.
  • General security hardening and code quality improvements.

1.1.4

  • Introduced feature gating, including limits on active campaigns and advanced features.
  • Enhanced performance and stability across popup rendering and trigger handling.
  • Fixed minor UI inconsistencies in the popup builder.
  • Improved overall compatibility with latest WordPress versions.
  • General bug fixes and internal code optimizations.

1.1.3

  • Added additional editor settings for improved layout control: – Margin Top & Bottom options for Image, Text, Coupon Code, Countdown, Button, Logo, GDPR, and Form fields (Name, Email, Message).
  • Added Button Hover Color setting for enhanced design customization.
  • Added a new GDPR Consent block to better handle compliance requirements.
  • Added new Countdown block settings including Timer Mode configuration.
  • Added an Onboarding screen with a simple 3-step guided setup for new users.

1.1.2

  • Added Popup Impressions, Conversions, and Conversion Rate tracking with visual charts.
  • Added Device-wise Conversion Analytics to view performance segmented by Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet.
  • Added Conversion Source Tracking to identify where conversions originate from.
  • Added Google Analytics (GA4) integration for enhanced tracking and reporting.

1.1.1

  • Added alphabetical sorting option (A–Z) to organize popup campaigns by title.
  • Added bulk delete option to remove all campaigns at once, with confirmation prompt.
  • Added “Save as Draft” option in Display Rules to store incomplete campaigns.
  • Displayed draft campaigns separately in the Campaigns list.
  • Added a News and Updates icon on the dashboard to show plugin announcements.

1.1.0

  • Added popup animation controls
  • Added exit animation when closing popups
  • Added floating bar popup type
  • Added floating bar position configuration
  • Added 3 Christmas popup templates
  • Added 2 Christmas form templates
  • Added 5 ready-to-use floating bar templates

1.0.2

  • Added dynamic text replacement
  • Added URL parameter targeting
  • Added geo targeting
  • Added auto-close option

1.0.1

  • Added two-step popup support
  • Added scroll percentage and inactivity triggers
  • Added popup animations and positions
  • Added link trigger
  • Added reCAPTCHA support
  • Added browser and OS targeting
  • Added new templates
  • Added CSV export
